pages.title: Touken Danshi's Independent Experience
pages.text: The mod adds an independent experience and level system for Touken Danshi. The maximum level is 99. After reaching level 99, experience continues to accumulate, up to a cap of 9,999,999.$(br2)If you have questions about experience or stat mechanics, please read the source code or decompile the mod. The author does not answer such questions.

pages.title: Leveling Disabled by Default
pages.text: Touken Danshi do not collect experience orbs by default. A command is required to toggle this on or off.$(br2)Use the /tr xp command to allow Touken Danshi to collect experience orbs.
